summary: Iteration 2 — Command Center. Backend /api/dashboard/summary and frontend Command Center fully functional. All 4 pytest backend tests pass (auth-gate, shape, KPI values, logistics read). Frontend visual + interaction test confirms title, DEMO chip, live indicator with pulsing dot, all 6 KPIs (11/3/2/4/4/7), 7 active incidents (RESOLVED excluded), 12 vehicle markers, 7 incident markers, 4 supply cards, MapLibre canvas renders at 1536x848 with OSM tiles, layer toggles hide/show vehicles + incidents, legend with 6 status colors, all 8 gov nav items, logout works, 10s polling resets the counter (observed 7s→1s→0s). One issue: /logistics workspace page does not render NavRail — logistics operator sees a standalone top bar with 'Sign out' instead of the role-scoped NavRail (Workspace/Fleet/Routes/Alerts). NavRail role-scoping logic itself is correct.

ui_bugs.issue: NavRail is not rendered on /logistics; logistics operator cannot access Workspace/Fleet/Routes/Alerts sidebar navigation. NavRail role-scoping (NAV_GROUPS.logistics) is correctly implemented but the page doesn't mount <NavRail/>.

action_items: Render <NavRail/> on the LogisticsWorkspace / PostLoginStub page (and any other role-scoped landing page) so role-scoped navigation is visible to logistics operators.
critical_code_review_comments: NerMap.jsx line 145 uses `SEVERITY` object defined at bottom of file (line 155) — works due to module hoisting but readability suffers; move the const to the top with STATUS_COLORS.
dashboard_summary iterates roads twice (once to build features, once for KPIs) — fine at 10 rows, but if roads scale up consider a single pass.
CommandCenter polls every 10s and drops the previous request result on error silently (only sets banner); OK for demo, but no exponential backoff.
seed_dashboard only seeds when collection is empty — good for idempotence, but any schema drift in future iterations will require manual clearing.
Attribution control passed as object `attributionControl: { compact: true }` in MapLibre v6 — verify constructor accepts option object vs boolean; currently renders OK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Command Center at /command-center is fully green. Only remaining issue is that /logistics (PostLoginStub) does not include the NavRail component. When retesting, verify NavRail appears on all authenticated role landing pages and that logistics user sees exactly Workspace/Fleet/Routes/Alerts items (no Command/Incidents/Supply/Predictions/Audit).
rca of the issue: LogisticsWorkspace/PostLoginStub page (frontend/src/pages/PostLoginStub.jsx) renders its own header without importing NavRail. Fix: wrap the page layout in the same flex+NavRail structure as CommandCenter.jsx (see lines 63-66).
